title: Lower weight decay (WEIGHT_DECAY 0.2 -> 0.1)
description: Halved cautious Muon weight decay from 0.2 to 0.1, all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.003940 vs baseline 1.002279 - a small regression, not an improvement. This is the fifth consecutive round where a single-axis hyperparameter perturbation (depth up, matrix_lr up, matrix_lr down, warmdown up, now weight_decay down) has failed to beat the DEPTH=10 baseline, suggesting the baseline sits in a fairly flat, well-tuned local optimum across these axes. Future rounds should probably stop doing isolated 1D sweeps of already-tuned scalars and instead try a genuinely different lever (e.g. window_pattern, MLP expansion ratio, aspect_ratio independent of depth, or combining two previously-near-neutral changes) rather than another single-knob nudge.
